Method of Attack: Phishing kit hosted on hacked legitimate WordPress websites
Brute-force login using common credential pairs
Installation of file management plugin to upload phishing kit
Phishing pages mimicking PayPal with URL rewriting and styled forms
CAPTCHA challenge to create false legitimacy
Requesting extensive personal and financial information including payment card data, social security number, mother's maiden name, card PIN
Requesting linking of victim's email account to PayPal for token access

Phishing pages hosted on hacked sites
Social engineering via phishing forms and CAPTCHA
File upload vulnerability in phishing kit
